reviews.body:
thank you for the contribution! 

please see comments. 
It is better to have this handling on JSON library exception. May be remembering last raw line would help. 

Current implementation will degrade performance.

review_comments.body:
- if there is an exception - it make sense to throw it when detected. 
- strings like `exception` should be a constants 
- ServerException should not be constructed with assumed code if it is unknown - it should be constant and somethin like `-1` otherwise it will be hard to handle different exceptions.
this method would be somewhere in ClientUtils or similar. There are different code formats and we usually check for some string - not just dot.

please replicate this logic from clickhouse-js https://github.com/ClickHouse/clickhouse-js/pull/1085/changes#diff-a25af8931a1e9a25e3aa2ba71bfcc1f11cb4ab875e902b7100d17009250bdc52R76

This is most recent one and should work with different version

we may not guarantee the order and we should make another check. 
besides - here we could also check type.
and even more optimize because schema not changing - so we can bake another condition.

please convert to integration tests. 
Unit tests do not verify client behavior with different database versions.

this should be under feature flag because currently it is on hot path. 
exception will be different in most cases when deserialization happens - so this feature doesn't not add much value. 
having an option to read server code is good - but only as option.
